source_evidence: Player exact 'Yes, and negotiate payment.' Authorizes inspection of frontier report and negotiation, not contract acceptance or limited feature expenditure. V reads existing report first issued D306 and received in Caereth D313 (correct prior narration ambiguous seven-days-ago receipt; actual dates remain as prior chunk). Observations of differing national banners and similar field tactics on separate nights are leads not attribution; no hidden roster, sponsor, operational timetable or future attack established. Councillor independently offers commission within newly established limited intelligence discretion, not authority to wage war, and written liaison introduction. Before RNG set base1000, DC14 1200, DC18 1500, DC23 1800 and200 signing advance credited against total, no competing patron knowledge revealed. Elara provides meaningful Help with political/strategic value; genuine visible python_user_visible secrets batch 622a28602781e3d0ca3e91b90e7fa1e3 d20 faces15,5 choose15+Persuasion6+Luckstone1=22. No Guidance or V feature spent. Offer1500gp split500 identification corroborated report and1000 authenticated sponsor chain/usable intelligence; distinct Crown deliverables, no double claim on identical objective. No automatic assent, advance, payment or letter transfer; user decides. Existing Kestrel copying under supervision continues, no completed certification claimed. D315~11:45 Caereth palace private council chamber, V/Elara/Mara/Cirren/Fenar with security councillor and secretary. V reads actual Orseld frontier warning dated D306, forwarded and received D313; reports separate armed raids under differing Ossent/Crownsunder colors and notably similar tactics, no confirmed perpetrator or sponsor, no established next attack or target/time. Councillor offers written introduction for lawful independent inquiries through frontier liaison contacts; no actual journey/letter custody yet. Negotiation: Elara meaningfully Helps explain strategic value, genuine visible Python secrets advantage d20 faces15,5 select15 +V Persuasion6 +Luckstone1=22. Predeclared Crown intelligence fee tiers below14 1000gp,14–17 1200gp,18–22 1500gp,23+ 1800gp and 200gp signing advance credited toward total. Result 1500gp contingent offer:500gp for substantiated account identifying responsible raiding organization with corroborated evidence and safely obtained witness information,1000gp for authenticated chain to actual sponsor/controller and usable intelligence enabling Crown response. No kill bounty, no payment for mere suspicion or already presented Kestrel evidence, no duplicate payment for identical milestone with other patron; distinct independently contracted objectives may be negotiated when actually offered. No signature/acceptance, cash, advance, commission or authority to wage war yet. V may accept or choose to press with Commanding Presence, still unspent. Kestrel supervised copying begun but not certified complete, originals V-held and physical exhibits Fenar-held, no new evidence transfer or public statement. Guild Defense meeting late afternoon D315 still planned; all other holdings/custody/resources unchanged. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 all features full, cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 full slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots equipped; Mara/Elara/horses healthy. Rest5/6 food21/feed28 purse203gp4sp6cp, conditional240gp sale unpaid. Dice delegated until stop.
